name: decision_reason
description: Decision.reason: why a judgement changed, retaining existing restatement reason codes and the approved regression reason.

definitions.regression: A previously resolved finding is open again because a regression was introduced.
definitions.data_error: A new judgement corrects erroneous data in an earlier judgement.
definitions.schema_migration: A restatement is needed because of a schema migration; original statements remain immutable.
definitions.baseline_rewrite: An existing baseline restatement reason; it does not authorize rewriting historical bytes.
definitions.operator_error: A new judgement corrects an operator error.

standard.none: Project-defined vocabulary owned by the existing data model.
